title: A Rigid Category of DNA Secondary Structures
summary: We construct a strict pivotal monoidal category $\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{DNA}}$ whose objects are DNA sequences (words over $\{A,C,G,T\}$) and whose morphisms are isotopy classes of typed noncrossing planar matchings, composed of through-strands and Watson-Crick-typed arcs, in a rectangle with source and target boundaries. The dual of a sequence is its reverse complement, evaluation and coevaluation are canonical duplex pairings, and the snake identities hold by planar isotopy.
